- Radio with AM/FM Stereo, SYNC 3, Bluetooth connectivity, and dual USB ports

The rear-wheel drive configuration provides stability when carrying loads, while the cargo tie-down hooks ensure your freight stays secure during transport. With just 11,584 miles on the odometer, this vehicle is nearly new and ready to serve your business from day one.

The white exterior maintains a professional appearance suitable for any commercial fleet, while the rear cargo door and passenger-side glass provide convenient access and visibility. The interior features durable vinyl front bucket seats designed to withstand the demands of daily commercial use. SYNC 3 connectivity keeps you integrated with your mobile devices through Bluetooth and USB ports, so you can manage important calls and navigation without distraction.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a low tire pressure warning system. Electronic stability control and traction control help maintain confidence in various driving conditions. The exterior upgrade package, which includes the honeycomb mesh grille with chrome surround and black HID lamps, adds a refined appearance while improving nighttime visibility.

This Transit-250 comes equipped with essential convenience features including power door mirrors, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, illuminated entry, and front reading lights. The rear-window defroster ensures clear visibility in all weather conditions. Four keys with fobs provide flexibility for multiple drivers managing your fleet.

We invite you to inspect this Ford Transit-250 Base in person and discuss how it can meet your commercial transportation needs. Our team is ready to answer questions and help you explore financing options tailored to your business.

Beach Chevrolet is Myrtle Beach's trusted source for Chevrolet commercial vehicles and fleet solutions. We proudly serve small businesses, contractors, municipalities, government agencies, and fleet operators throughout Myrtle Beach, Conway, North Myrtle Beach, Murrells Inlet, Georgetown, Florence, and the surrounding areas.

From Silverado work trucks and HD pickups to Express cargo vans and upfit-ready fleet vehicles, we offer the right tools to keep your business moving. Whether you need one vehicle or an entire fleet, our Commercial Sales team delivers competitive pricing, financing solutions, and dedicated support tailored to your operation.

Partner with Beach Chevrolet for reliable commercial vehicles, fleet expertise, and exceptional service across the Grand Strand.

description:
Meet the 2015 Ford Transit-350 Base, a capable work vehicle built to handle the demands of your business operations. Whether you run a delivery service, trades operation, or require dependable commercial transportation, this Transit-350 delivers the functionality and reliability you need on the job.

- Dual bucket seats with driver-side manual lumbar support
- AM/FM single-CD stereo with HD and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Rear-view camera with Trailer Hitch Assist
- Cruise control with message center and trip computer
- LED load compartment lighting package
- Load area protection package with full-height polypropylene panels
- 16 steel wheels with full silver cover
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Power steering and power windows
- Remote keyless entry
- Dual front impact airbags with occupant sensing

This Transit-350 is powered by a 3.7L V6 Ti-VCT engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, delivering the performance needed for commercial use. The rear-wheel drive configuration combined with a 3.73 limited slip axle ratio provides solid traction and handling under load.

The interior prioritizes worker comfort and functionality. Dual bucket seats with adjustable lumbar support on the drivers side ensure comfortable seating during long workdays. The overhead console and front map lights improve visibility and accessibility. Climate control keeps the cabin comfortable regardless of season, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel accommodates drivers of various sizes.

The cargo area is thoughtfully designed for commercial work. Full-height polypropylene panel protection on side walls and doors safeguards the cargo area from damage and wear. LED lighting throughout the load compartment ensures visibility when loading and unloading materials or equipment. The vehicle also includes CNG/Propane gaseous engine preparation capability for potential fuel conversion by external upfitters.

Safety features provide peace of mind on every route. Electronic stability control, traction control, and 4-wheel disc braking with ABS work together to maintain vehicle control. Dual front impact airbags protect front occupants, while the panic alarm offers additional security when the vehicle is parked.

The Transit-350 Base represents straightforward, honest commercial transportation. This vehicle comes ready to work and has been engineered to meet the rigorous demands of business use. Inside, you'll find modern conveniences designed to enhance every journey. The leather steering wheel, telescoping and tilt adjustments, and memory seat functions allow personalized comfort settings. The low tire pressure warning system and emergency communication capabilities add additional layers of security.

The ID. Buzz 1st Edition is built for those who value space, technology, and sustainable driving. With its combination of premium comfort features, safety systems, advanced navigation, and efficient electric performance, this vehicle is ready to serve your transportation needs reliably. We invite you to schedule a showroom visit to explore this innovative vehicle firsthand.

This 2022 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L is a well-maintained family vehicle ready to enhance your daily drives with its spacious interior and modern conveniences.

- Integrated Active Noise Cancellation
- Uconnect 5 with 10.1" Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Heated steering wheel and heated front seats
- Power driver seat with memory function
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Remote keyless entry
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- 3rd row split-bench seating
- Turn signal indicator mirrors
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Rear air conditioning
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 17" aluminum wheels

This Pacifica delivers reliable performance with its 3.6L V6 engine, achieving 19 city MPG and 28 highway MPG for balanced efficiency. The nine-speed automatic transmission offers smooth acceleration and responsive handling, while front-wheel drive ensures confident control in various driving conditions.

A CARFAX One Owner vehicle with a clean history and no accidents provides peace of mind. This certified pre-owned Pacifica has been thoroughly inspected and is backed by the confidence that comes from knowing its complete service record.

The Touring L trim combines practicality with comfort for families and commuters alike. Three rows of seating with split-folding rear seats provide flexibility for passengers and cargo, while the reclining third row ensures passenger comfort on longer journeys. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, making daily tasks more convenient.

Inside, the cabin features perforated leather trim bucket seats in the front and a host of driver-focused technology. The memory seat remembers your preferred driving position, the heated steering wheel adds winter comfort, and the comprehensive audio system with six speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained throughout your travels.

Safety is prioritized with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, a knee airbag, and overhead airbags, complemented by four-wheel disc brakes, ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control. Additional conveniences include rain-sensing wipers, rear window defroster, and an auto-dimming rear-view mirror.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this capable minivan for yourself. Contact us today to arrange your visit and discover why this 2022 Pacifica Touring L is the practical choice for your transportation needs.

This 2019 Honda Odyssey EX-L is a thoughtfully maintained minivan that brings together practicality, comfort, and reliability for families who value both space and capability.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 9-speed automatic transmission
- Seating for seven with heated front bucket seats and leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS) with forward collision warning
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS)
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning
- 160-Watt AM/FM/HD/SiriusXM audio system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Power liftgate and rear window wiper
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear dual-zone air conditioning
- Power driver seat with memory function
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror with HomeLink garage door transmitter
- 18" dark silver-painted alloy wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Emergency communication system (HondaLink)
- Parking camera with rearview display

The interior reflects the EX-L's commitment to passenger comfort. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone comfortable, while the heated front leather seats provide warmth during colder months. The power driver seat with memory means you can easily restore your perfect driving position each time you get behind the wheel. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone's key functions at your fingertips through the SiriusXM-equipped audio system, and the power moonroof adds an open-air element to your drive.

Safety technology is woven throughout this minivan. The Collision Mitigation Braking System works actively to help prevent or reduce the severity of forward collisions, while Lane Keeping Assist helps you maintain your position on the road. The Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, and the standard array of airbags—including front, side, and overhead protection—provides comprehensive coverage for all passengers. A rearview parking camera assists with backing up safely.

The 3.5L V6 engine delivers balanced performance with good efficiency, achieving 19 mpg in city driving and 28 mpg on the highway. The nine-speed automatic transmission provides smooth transitions between gears, while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections effectively. Speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness based on your driving speed, and the electronic stability control system helps maintain traction in challenging conditions.

Practicality extends to the vehicle's design. The power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless, especially when your hands are full. Split-folding rear seating and a reclining third-row bench give you flexibility in how you configure the cabin for passengers or cargo. Three rows of seating accommodate seven occupants, making this minivan well-suited for larger families or those who regularly transport groups.

With 78,304 miles on the odometer, this Odyssey demonstrates responsible ownership and has years of dependable service remaining. The EX-L trim strikes an excellent balance between features and value. If you're seeking a capable family vehicle that prioritizes comfort, safety, and practicality, we invite you to schedule a time to see this minivan in person and experience its thoughtful design firsthand.

Safety is integrated throughout with electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system including front and side airbags, plus knee and overhead protection. The ParkView backup camera helps you navigate parking situations with greater visibility, while rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions.

Meet the 2020 Ram ProMaster City Tradesman SLT, a versatile work vehicle ready to handle your professional demands with proven reliability and practical design.

- Full size spare tire
- Uconnect 3 infotainment system with 5" touchscreen display
- Integrated voice command with Bluetooth connectivity
- Rear exterior parking camera
- Remote keyless entry
- Air conditioning
- Power steering and windows
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with HD stabilization
- Heated power door mirrors
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls
- Front bucket seats with premium cloth upholstery
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags

This ProMaster City combines efficiency with comfort, delivering up to 21 city miles per gallon and 28 highway miles per gallon. The 2.4L four-cylinder engine paired with a nine-speed automatic transmission provides a balanced approach to fuel economy without sacrificing capability. The 3.73 axle ratio supports confident handling whether you're navigating urban streets or highway corridors.

The cabin prioritizes functionality with thoughtful features designed for the working professional. The Uconnect 3 system puts navigation and connectivity at your fingertips through the intuitive touchscreen interface. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep you focused on the road, while integrated voice command with Bluetooth allows hands-free operation of your mobile device. Premium cloth bucket seats provide all-day comfort, and the spacious interior maximizes your ability to transport tools, equipment, or cargo.

This vehicle is backed by Triton Certified Classic status, signifying that it has undergone comprehensive inspection and meets our rigorous quality standards. Your purchase includes a three-month, 4,000-mile comprehensive warranty for added peace of mind. We also offer a five-day return option and thirty-day exchange policy, allowing you the flexibility to make your decision with confidence. Our Auto Reward Program provides additional benefits as a valued customer.

The safety features integrated throughout this ProMaster City demonstrate the manufacturer's commitment to occupant protection. Dual front impact airbags work alongside dual front side impact airbags and a knee airbag to provide comprehensive coverage. Electronic Stability Control and traction control help maintain grip in variable conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension with HD stabilization keeps the vehicle composed during daily operation. The rear exterior parking camera assists with visibility during reversing maneuvers.

Practical touches throughout the vehicle enhance usability. Delay-off headlights illuminate your approach at dawn and dusk, while the block heater aids cold-weather starts in demanding climates. Variably intermittent wipers adapt to rainfall intensity, and the outside temperature display keeps you informed of conditions. This white exterior maintains its clean appearance with body-color bumpers and integrated bodyside moldings.

This 2020 Ram ProMaster City Tradesman SLT stands ready to support your business operations while delivering the safety, comfort, and efficiency you expect. With certified status, warranty coverage, and our customer-focused policies, this vehicle represents a solid choice for professionals who value both performance and value.
